tasks.short: Keep abreast of endoscopy developments through literature, colleagues, organizations and conferences.

inputs: existing journal access and professional event listings
outputs: checked source and event shortlist with dates and access limits

steps.what: Select relevant endoscopy developments to study and decide which professional participation is appropriate
inputs: checked source and event shortlist with dates and access limits
outputs: chosen reading, discussion and participation plan

inputs: chosen reading, discussion and participation plan

Send the approved registration to the actual external professional event organizer
Read current endoscopy literature, talk with colleagues and actually participate in organizations or conferences
inputs: chosen reading, discussion and participation plan
actual source texts and professional discussions
actual event confirmation where registration is needed

actual participation evidence or reading references

Commit the approved actual learning record to the internal professional development log

tasks.design: Configure native saved literature searches and event filters in {OTHER}, the existing journal library and professional event directory; {DOCS} holds reading references. The technician chooses material and learns by reading, colleague discussion and actual participation. Native registration templates reduce repeated entry; final registration approval precedes its distinct external {EMAIL} send. Actual participation evidence and learning are captured afterward and separately approved before a distinct {LMS} record commit. Changes void approval. No model-generated source, assumed attendance or automatic clinical procedure change is proposed.
tasks.previous_blocker: Finding relevant current sources and re-entering registration and learning records adds handling around professional learning.
tasks.enabler_now: Native saved searches, registration templates and controlled development logs.
tasks.still_hard: Judging evidence quality and relating developments to actual endoscopy practice.
tasks.human_edge: Ask colleagues questions and decide what deserves deeper study.

ambition.what: Reduce search and record handling around existing professional learning.

tasks.altitude: Evidence appraisal and professional participation remain human.

reach.learn: Distinguish actual participation from registration and new knowledge from approved local practice.

evidence.claim: Native library saved searches and learning-record templates can reduce repeated retrieval and field entry.

assumptions: Shares are provisional across a mix of reading, discussions and events, not observed. Event registration shares are aggregate allocations; no registration is required for ordinary reading or colleague discussion.

s1 manually enters topic and date filters and checks author, publication date, source identity and access. s3 includes actual event ID, date, participant, fee and destination capture; no ready registration record is assumed.
The technician operates within an already authorized learning budget; if additional employer authorization is required it must be separately counted before external registration.

s6 retains full reading and participation effort and checks actual event confirmation. s7 manually enters actual date, source reference, participation proof, learning points and questions. Registration never proves completion.

The development log is assumed part of existing work; where no log exists, remove that baseline and benefit. Any change to local clinical procedures requires separate authorized work with no saving claimed here.
unknowns: Actual learning mix, library indexing and development-log practice.
research_questions: Do saved searches reduce relevant-source finding after source and access checks?

already_counted.description: Actual learning record capture and final record review.

incremental.description: Maintain saved-search topics and registration/log fields.

approvals.approved_version: complete actual registration details, fee and exact external organizer destination
actual completed learning record, source and participation evidence and internal log location

time_saved_range_pct.basis: High:7.5 course search, two registration preparation and two actual external-send hours saved less one upkeep. Low: native catalogue and registration remove new benefit. Same-learning-log commitment and actual participation retain full effort.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Professional endoscopy learning supported by native source finding and actual participation records.
reach: Educators and colleagues discuss evidence without treating registration as completed learning.
role.ambitious_version: Reduce administrative handling while preserving reading, discussion and professional judgement.
